text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "What kind of person is Pearl?" You came to me, a princess, for that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to ask Kawakami Princess,
Seeking the Pearl's roommate,
about
Pearl's everyday behavior.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let me think... Pearl is always loud and full
of energy, but every now
and then she
becomes uncharacteristically quiet. For
example...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The other day, a group of us were trying
the "Super Spicy Takoyaki
Roulette." Pearl
yelled, "Nothing is impossible for me—I
won't get the
spicy one!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even when there was only one left, and
everyone knew what it was,
she gobbled it
down fearlessly. Let me tell you, she got
reeeal quiet
after that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just because something isn't technically impossible, that doesn't make it any less unlikely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had believed that Seeking the Pearl was
more than just a boisterous
loudmouth,
but maybe I was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I think back to the
scrimmage where she got labeled
"difficult
to work with."

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Seeking the Pearl is going
sideways out of the gate,
straight to the
outer edge of the track! Did she hit the
gate on her
way out?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm on the outermost lane, and currently in
last place...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But! If you think I'm waving the white flag
here, then you've got
another one coming!
Never surrender!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Pearl? You're entering your last
spurt from that position?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl, I'm impressed you made
it to third after that start,
but why did you
go sideways in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The reason... I ran sideways...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Open your ears and listen carefully. There,
you can hear it, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I close my eyes and try to listen...

text_block_list.name: Bento Seller
text_block_list.text:
Bentos, bentos! ♪ Get them hot and
fresh! ♪ Only 500 yen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was charmed by that voice! Bento
boxes—they're one of my favorite
foods!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, the race is over, so I'm going to grab
lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is she joking, or is she serious about that
being her reason? Either
way, Seeking the
Pearl dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I can't get a read on her at all. The
fact she managed to
recover after such a
poor start speaks volumes to her talent...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
But I just don't know about her
personality. I've never heard of an

Umamusume who runs sideways just
because she heard someone
selling bento
boxes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She did say that, but I feel like there's
more to it than just that. I
mean, she
doesn't look like the type to be super
fascinated by bento
boxes anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What is she hiding? Let's see... when it
comes to bentos...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to unravel the mystery, I find
myself scanning bento stalls in
the mall's
deli on my day off. I guess Seeking the
Pearl's words are
still on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence. If it isn't the
trainer who wanted to turn the
world
upside-down. Are bento boxes your hobby
as well?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I don't blame you—it's not easy to
pass up the International
Bento Fair.
Come, let's go eat while we take a stroll
by the shore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I guess bentos really are her hobby. And
so, I enjoy an unexpected,
but not
unwelcome, dinner with Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was magnificent. It was like a
jewelry box brimming with
the sights of the
world...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even the Italian roast lamb and the French
croquette were customized
to fit in the
bento box...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This meal was a tribute to limitless
possibility. Each food is
well-defined, and
yet each item has its own individuality.
This goes
both for side dishes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And for us Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl's final sentence shows me a glimpse
into her inner dialogue.
Perhaps I wasn't
mistaken...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pluck up my courage and ask her the
question that's been on my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why I ran sideways? Ah, you mean that
scrimmage from the other day.
I believe I
already answered this question, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was charmed by the bento seller's voice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're a little different from the
rest. But, you know...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I don't hate that. Right, I'll spill the beans.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you the truth. Think of it as a
dessert to our meal, okay? ♪
